name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LinearHop.card_killed_le_finrank
title: Per-hop kill count: at most dim V positions can be killed by a linear hop that spares all later positions
statement: Let V be a finite-dimensional vector space over a field K, h_0, ..., h_{M-1} linear functionals on V (decryption functionals of planted witnesses, in hybrid order) and, for each r, L_r : U -> V a linear map (the embedding of the challenge in the hop at witness r). The number of indices r such that h_t o L_r = 0 for every t > r (the hop leaves every later functional untouched) and h_r o L_r != 0 (the hop touches functional r) is at most dim V. Used in note pq-we-linear-hop-barrier.
